# The one list of release input paths (#3095): what can change the shipped package.
# The "changes" job of release-binaries.yml turns it into the paths-filter rules with
# `node scripts/release/release-inputs.mjs --emit-filters`, and the publish gate
# scripts/check-release-candidate.mjs reads it to decide whether a changed file is a release input.
# One pattern per line: an exact path, or a directory prefix ending in "/**". Blank lines and
# lines starting with "#" are ignored. This file lists itself, so changing the rules needs a new
# release candidate like any other release input change.
.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml
.github/release-inputs.txt
package.json
bun.lock
cli/**
scripts/release-binaries.sh
scripts/release/**
tests/e2e/platforms/container-image/**
.github/workflows/publish-cli-image.yml
runtime/**
